reason: I already pay for ChatGPT and get most of this by copy-pasting, so I don't see what three 'co-workers' add until I see one actually working inside my Google Workspace and that CRM nobody updates. I might open the free plan out of curiosity, but I'm not paying 99 € a month on a landing page promise.
objection: 'Connects to the tools you already use' is what everyone says, and then it doesn't connect to the specific ones I use, or only half-works. I also have no idea what 100 credits actually buys me in a month.
would_change_my_mind: A demo on my own Google Workspace and CRM where the AI sales co-worker updates the CRM and follows up leads on its own, with a clear idea of how far 100 credits go.
